sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: practical staple carb source. Tubers are often judged by how usable they are day to day. Can be quite filling. A useful practical strength when the preparation stays sensible. Whole-food carb package. That matters because it is a cleaner baseline than heavily refined carbs.
